svg.title: Known-best packing of 179 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=179 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Finite feasibility of 179 unit squares at the exact algebraic side L70+5=L207-1. Construction credited to Doğa Özden after Ryan Xu and Evan Daniel; algebraic certificate credited to Joost de Winter. The reported GeiserX starting file and its identity remain unresolved. No optimality, stationarity or historical-priority claim.

svg.text: U n=179 known best: side ~ 13.88096037 (certified upper bound)
